rules.name: Zero-Trust Security & Key Protection
rules.description: Never expose Gemini or Google Maps API keys to the client; isolate Firestore tenant paths and verify auth tokens.
directives: Never emit client-side Gemini or Google Maps API keys.
All Firestore operations must use /users/{uid}/journals/{id} paths.
Every API route must execute adminAuth.verifyIdToken(token) before downstream execution.

rules.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines Design System
rules.description: Ensure clean visual hierarchy, legible typography, fluid motion, and dark mode compliance.
directives: Follow Apple HIG principles: Clarity, Deference, and Depth.
Use rounded continuous corner radii, subtle blur materials, and accessible contrast ratios.
Incorporate spring physics animations for interaction states.

rules.name: Maps API Proxy Directives
rules.description: Ensure all Google Maps API queries are proxied via backend routes with input validation and rate limiting.
directives: Proxy all Maps API calls through backend route handlers.
Authenticate caller tokens and sanitize all coordinate/query inputs.

rules.name: Pre-Commit Secret Scanning & TDD Enforcement
rules.description: Block hardcoded secrets and enforce passing tests prior to git commits.
directives: Block hardcoded API keys and credentials in staged commits.
Execute automated test suites (security.test.ts and sanitizer.test.ts) before git commits.
